**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation.

**Proposed Solution**

- [ ] Layer 1: Infrastructure & Config
- [ ] Layer 2: Observability & Tracing
- [ ] Layer 4: Policy & Verification
- [ ] Layer 5: Memory & Continuous Hopfield Substrate
- [ ] Layer 6: Tools & Sandboxing
- [ ] Layer 7: Model Plane (CortexLM, Local SLM)
- [ ] Layer 8: Orchestrator & State Machine
- [ ] Layer 10: Product Surfaces (Studio, CLI)

**Alternatives Considered**
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Scientific or Empirical Baseline**
How will this feature be measured against a simpler baseline?
